comparison.objective: Stage and time a gravity release so a ball enters an empty moving tray; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Gate sequencing and motion timing versus fine mechanical adjustment, locking, and diagnosis from repeated impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Ball lands in the empty rather than occupied tray under varied layouts versus two safe stops with retained adjustment. No separate specs or tray tolerances are provided.
comparison.reason: Predictive timing of a ballistic release is not dynamic damping calibration.
